g.text: Sentiment classification: risk tolerance and selective coverage

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243247

g.text: Error: accepted sentiment differs from the human reference. At the 15% budget, observed TEST error is 810 / 5,333 = 15.1884%.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243247

g.text: Source calibration does not guarantee risk on a shifted TEST population. The observed excess is preserved, without post-TEST adaptation.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243247

g.text: Only one predicted-neutral post is accepted at 5%. These class slices are descriptive; delta = 0.05 per budget gives no class-level guarantee.
